mapper.select:
SELECT voca.id, voca.vocalevel, (SELECT codename FROM cmm_code WHERE code = voca.vocalevel AND codetype = 'VOCALEVEL') vocalevel_name, voca.vocano, voca.word, voca.explain, voca.answer FROM ttokssaemdb.voca voca
AND voca.id = ${id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.voca ( vocalevel, vocano, word, `explain`, answer ) VALUES ( #{vocalevel}, ${vocano}, #{word}, #{explain}, #{answer} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE ttokssaemdb.voca SET vocalevel = #{vocalevel}, vocano = ${vocano}, word = #{word}, `explain` = #{explain}, answer = #{answer}
AND id = ${id}
